paragraphs.text: BLOCK (L-SEAT-LOSS): 8-1/2 in production: ECD 1.35 sg in the Barail reaches 1.31 sg, the lowest ECD at which offsets lost returns there (loss probability 48%, 90 % interval 25%-71%). Set casing above the loss band or lower the mud weight.
WARN (L-MUD-STUCK): 8-1/2 in production: water-based mud through the Kopili, where stuck pipe probability is 30%. Consider an inhibitive system or OBM/SBM.
WARN (L-MW-KICK): 8-1/2 in production: minimum MW 1.15 sg in the Kopili is below 1.40 sg: offsets took kicks there at 1.35 sg (kick probability 24%).
